description: Credit-card and revolving-balance payoff in exact cents. Give a balance, an annual percentage rate, and a fixed payment (or a minimum that is the greater of a percent of the new balance and a floor). Returns the months to zero, total interest, total paid, and a yearly rollup. Interest each month is round-half-up of balance × APR / 12. The last payment is the remaining balance plus that month's interest. Refuses a payment that does not cover the interest. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/credit-payoff

minFloor.description: Minimum payment floor used with minPercent, default 0

minPercent.description: Instead of a fixed payment: percent of the new balance (after interest)

start.description: First payment date YYYY-MM-DD. Later payments fall on the same day, clamped to the month end
